pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition on adding to positions unless the initial trade is in positive territory by at least 2.5x the dollar risk amount.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Require a minimum 3-candle momentum confirmation and distance filter from immediate liquidity pools before opening XAUUSD positions.
profit_harvest_threshold: Scale out 50% at +$5.00 profit, and trail remaining position using an ATR-based dynamic stop to capture asymmetric +$15.00 to +$30.00 runs.
